messages:
Alex Chen: hi everyone \/ I'm Alex, starting today on eng-runtime as a Serving Engineer. quick q: my MDM enrolment got stuck on 'Waiting for approval' and i can't access corp VPN. also need access to the dev-k8s namespace and CUDA-enabled test nodes. fun fact: i used to build pedal steel guitars in college.
Priya (People Ops): welcome Alex!! :tada: i'll look into the MDM status. can you DM me your laptop serial and preferred tshirt size? your onboarding buddy is Jordan — he'll help with infra access.
Jordan (Infra): hey Alex, welcome :wave: please share your corp email and github handle. for k8s access i need your corp email to add you to the dev-serve cluster rolebinding. if VPN fails, let me know the error you see.
Alex Chen: corp email: alex.chen@redwood.com, github: alexchen. For VPN I get: "Authentication failed: no valid certificate" when trying to connect via WireGuard on mac. Laptop serial is WDX1Z99ABC12.
Riley (DevEx): FYI we have a short checklist in docs: `docs/onboarding/first-week.md` — contains MDM, VPN, and git access steps. Also, if you need a pre-provisioned CUDA node, ping `#eng-runtime` with "bootnode-request" and Jordan can attach a node from the sandbox pool.
Priya (People Ops): MDM shows "Awaiting approval" for WDX1Z99ABC12. I'm approving now. You should get an enrollment popup — if not, reply here with "no-pop" and MDM Bot will resend. Welcome kit (stickers + mug) on its way.
MDM Bot: Enrollment approved for device WDX1Z99ABC12. Enrollment email has been sent to alex.chen@redwood.com. If you do not receive it, open a ticket in #help with tag `@Priya (People Ops)`.
Jordan (Infra): Added alex.chen@redwood.com to `dev-serve` ClusterRoleBinding. I reserved a CUDA test node (label: sandbox-gpu-0) and set a 24h hold. To ssh: `ssh alex@sandbox-gpu-0.internal.redwood`. If VPN still blocks, use bastion with your corp key — i added your key to `~/.ssh/authorized_keys`.
Alex Chen: got the MDM email and enrolled. VPN works after enrollment \/ thanks :raised_hands: could you confirm the SSH details again? I can't ssh: `permission denied (publickey)`.
Jordan (Infra): sorry, corrected — I appended your public key now. try `ssh -i ~/.ssh/id_rsa alex@sandbox-gpu-0.internal.redwood` and run `nvidia-smi`.
Alex Chen: yay `nvidia-smi` shows GTX 3090 and CUDA 12.1. bench scripts start too. thanks team. would love a quick intro sync — afternoons PT work best.
Riley (DevEx): i'll drop a 30m "meet & sync" invite for tomorrow 2pm PT and add links to internal runbooks. PS — starter repo: `git@github.com:redwood/serve-examples` has a `hello-gpu/` demo.
Priya (People Ops): Added you to the "new hire first week" doc and scheduled a 1:1 with your manager. Also note: bring your favorite snack to the "team lunchtime" tomorrow if you're in SF :pizza:
Alex Chen: sweet. thanks everyone! excited to dive in and also happy to bring mini pies for the team :pie:
